C0506.title: How Fraudsters Mask Their Traces in International Bypass Fraud
C0506.summary: A 2024 academic study investigates how fraudsters conceal their tracks in international communication bypass fraud. The research extracts carrier network topologies and analyzes how fraudsters use emulators and other techniques to evade detection.

references.title: Battle of Wits: To What Extent Can Fraudsters Disguise Their Tracks in International bypass Fraud?
